Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear roster. From a finance forecasting perspective we have two asks/decisions:

1) Commit accounting policy for the current cadence: we will count GREEN as commit, YELLOW as contingent (50% weight) unless procurement provides explicit PO/firm approval, and RED as pipeline. That means for todays numbers: ACME-4962 contributes 0.5x its ARR to the commit line until PO is received.

2) Request final lock window: please provide absolute confirmation (PO or DocuSign link) by EOD Mon 2027-04-26. If we don't receive confirmation, we will move the weighted YELLOW into pipeline for Q2 close and not count it in the commit for planning.

A few quick notes on process hygiene to reduce churn:
- Use the MOP spreadsheet single source of truth and keep that sheet updated when demo or legal milestones change
- Flag any term deviations in the NOTES column and route to Mateo immediately for rapid escalation
- Use the Deal Health tag in Salesforce (Deal Health: RED/YELLOW/GREEN) and avoid ad-hoc probability edits without a short note explaining the rationale

If anyone expects a timing change, ping me and the revenue ops channel. I can also join the Monday call if helpful.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
